idea_name: Price-vs-time correlation as trend-strength and duration sensor
mechanism: Rolling Pearson/Spearman/Kendall/Fechner correlation of Close vs bar index over window N; |ρ| measures trend strength; time spent above a threshold (e.g. 0.75 for 3–4 bars) measures persistence; oscillator of Δρ level-breaks for entries.
data_needed: OHLC series; window rangeN; key level in [0,1]
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD; H1 examples; EA optimized on M1 OHLC 2015–2018
why_new_for_mis: Treats serial price–time dependence itself as a live regime feature (strength + duration), not just pairwise symbol correlation.
quote: The strength of the current trend - directly based on the current value of the correlation. The duration of the trend - based on the observation of the selected threshold value over time.

idea_name: Cross-symbol pattern scanners (air levels, parabolic, gap, extremes, directional days)
mechanism: Universe scan tabs: flat-range air levels (N bars within offset of high/low on M5–D1); parabolic higher-lows/lower-highs on M5; D1 gap ≥ gap_min%; 4-week and 52-week W1 high/low; price near .00/.50; ≥mostly_percent of last mostly_count D1 bars same direction; consecutive new highs/lows; session close at high/low ± offset.

instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Stocks/FX universe; M5/M15/M30/H1/H4/D1/W1 as configured per tab

idea_name: Gerchik ATR residual-range exhaustion and same-day trend filter
mechanism: Gerchik ATR: pre-average daily ranges, drop bars >2× or <0.3× that average, then ATR over up to 5 remaining days; report today_range/ATR% and discourage same-direction entries after ~80% ATR used. Also hide symbols whose today open→close direction ≠ yesterday.
data_needed: D1 OHLC; SYMBOL_ASK/BID for spread snapshot
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Intraday stocks/FX; D1 ATR; chart overlays on <D1; guiding symbols on D1+H1
why_new_for_mis: Outlier-trimmed daily range plus percent-of-ATR consumed is a concrete intraday volatility-budget sensor; day-direction consistency is a simple regime gate.
quote: if a symbol has already passed more than 80% of its daily ATR in one direction, then it makes no sense to make deals in the same direction

idea_name: Fractal-anchored trend slowdown and distancing OB/OS sensor
mechanism: Anchor to supporting fractal / MA–candle intersection as trend onset; then detect slowdown via shortening inter-fractal amplitudes, larger intra-candle correction/body shrinkage, pivot-shift flips; also treat bar-distance from onset (≈10–15 bars typical active life) as rising probability of OB/OS uncertainty zone.
data_needed: Multi-TF OHLC (M1+M15 examples); fractal extrema; optional Fib-tuned oscillators as baselines
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: USDCAD D1 examples; EURUSD; EA Reduce_risks on M1; general FX
why_new_for_mis: Frames OB/OS as fractal-referenced uncertainty zones with explicit slowdown and distancing rules, not fixed-period RSI/Stoch crossings.
quote: The further the current price (in bars) will move away from the trend onset (approaching to the numbers specified), the higher the probability of the ending trend will be

idea_name: Log-price step discretization with split-Bernoulli and Markov regime tests
mechanism: Discretize open prices into ±1 steps on a fixed % log grid (setmv); MLE for single p, for change-point (n1,p1,p2), and for two-state Markov (p_up|up, p_up|down); Fisher exact / binomial tests of p=p0 or p1=p2 detect direction regime shifts.
data_needed: M1 opens over interval; dprcnt step %; optional deal/bankruptcy Bernoulli reinterpretations
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD 0.5% steps 2020.05.20–2020.06.20; general assets with positive prices
why_new_for_mis: Gives a discrete-move likelihood toolkit for sensing trend vs mean-reversion regimes and statistically testing a break between two Bernoulli segments.
quote: Answer: n1e = 21; p1e = 0.71; p2e = 0.17 ... our model "detected" the price direction change (or correction) at the end of its segment.

idea_name: Fixed-amplitude block discretization to remove time-bar noise
mechanism: Argue time bars inject randomness because activity (steps) per bar is random; close a block only after price travels N points vertically (price-as-function-of-itself). Shows H1/D1 mean sizes ≈ √steps × mean step like a random walk; high/low vol clusters track tick count, not special dynamics. Prefer Renko-like blocks or tick blocks for analysis.
data_needed: Tick or fine OHLC; chosen N-point block size; optional tick volume
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: GBPUSD M1/H1/D1 2020.05.18–2020.07.03; BTCUSD weekly vs N-point blocks
why_new_for_mis: Reframes volatility/noise as a discretization artifact and proposes amplitude-based sampling as the primary sensing grid for MIS.
quote: by using time discretization, we convert a price series into a random sequence... This is the time discretization that leads to the so-called "noises" and non-stationarity

idea_name: Residual unit-root battery as spurious-relationship sensor
mechanism: Fit regressors (OHLC, MA, RSI, CCI, AO) to target; test residual stationarity with ADF, KPSS, Phillips–Perron (plus R² vs Durbin–Watson and lagged-predictor insignificance flags). Non-stationary residuals ⇒ spurious link; stationary residuals validate feature→target sensing before ONNX deploy.
data_needed: Bar OHLC + indicator buffers; train/test split; residual series
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD M1 EA example; 3000 bars export; growth target Close_t/Close_{t+15}
why_new_for_mis: Turns econometric residual diagnostics into a gate that MIS can use to accept/reject putative predictive sensors.
quote: if we can find unit roots for our residuals then our regression is spurious.

idea_name: Non-stationary regression failure modes and residual-ACF misspecification flag
mechanism: Monte Carlo: independent random walks yield inflated R² and ~75% false t-rejections; stationary AR(1) misspecification still inflates false positives. Require pre-stationarity (differences), then residual ACF within 99% bands and DW away from 0 before trusting t-stats.
data_needed: Paired series X,Y; OLS residuals; ACF lag K
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Synthetic RW and AR(1); methods aimed at general financial time series
why_new_for_mis: Operational checklist for when cross-series MIS regressions are sensing vs spurious under non-stationarity.
quote: Attempts to apply regression analysis to non-stationary processes can lead to false conclusions about the presence of a significant relationship

idea_name: Two-sample KS day-homogeneity as non-stationarity and adaptive-lookback sensor
mechanism: iSmirnovDistance: each new D1 bar, KS two-sample λ between prior two sessions’ M5 log-increments; λ > Kolmogorov critical (α=0.05 ⇒ D≈0.1133 for n≈287) flags distribution-law change. Adaptive rule: grow estimation window until H0 rejected, then reset—lookback length tracks regime life.
data_needed: M5 (or M1) log-returns segmented by trading day; alpha
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD and XAUUSD M1 analysis; indicator on D1 using M5; n≈1440 M1 / ≈287 M5 per day
why_new_for_mis: Direct empirical-CDF change detector that also defines a data-driven regime lifetime for other MIS indicators’ sample size.
quote: for calculations, it is necessary to take the volume of data that falls within the time period between two deviations of the homogeneity null hypothesis.
